activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: A customer is necessarily an employee of the shop.
cards.explanation: Customer es quien compra o recibe el servicio, no quien trabaja allí.

cards.statement: Overtime means a permanent contract.
cards.explanation: Overtime es trabajo adicional fuera del horario normal.

cards.statement: She is responsible for organising the rota.
cards.explanation: Responsible for va seguido de un sustantivo o gerundio.

cards.statement: Work can be uncountable when it means activity, while job is countable.
cards.explanation: Decimos some work pero one job o two jobs.

cards.statement: A salary is usually paid regularly, for example each month.
cards.explanation: Salary es un sueldo periódico.

cards.statement: An hourly wage is the name of a professional career.
cards.explanation: An hourly wage es un pago calculado por hora.

cards.statement: Flexible hours must always be exactly the same every day.
cards.explanation: Flexible significa que el horario puede adaptarse.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: I applied for a job online.
cards.explanation: Apply for a job es una colocación correcta.

cards.statement: A temporary job is expected to last for a limited period.
cards.explanation: Temporary significa limitado en el tiempo.

cards.statement: I applied a job at the hospital.
cards.explanation: Se necesita la preposición for: applied for a job.

cards.statement: A colleague is the person who pays your salary.
cards.explanation: Colleague es compañero; normalmente el employer paga el salario.

cards.statement: I earn a salary from my employer.
cards.explanation: Earn se usa para el dinero que recibes por tu trabajo.

cards.statement: You can apply for a job, but you cannot apply a job.
cards.explanation: La preposición for es necesaria después de apply en este significado.

cards.statement: A career describes a person's professional path over time.
cards.explanation: Career se refiere a la trayectoria profesional.

cards.statement: The manager invited the candidate to an interview.
cards.explanation: An interview es una entrevista de selección.

activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: She has a part-time job at a café.
cards.explanation: Job es un puesto concreto y part-time indica jornada parcial.

cards.statement: I have two works at the moment.
cards.explanation: Para dos puestos concretos se dice two jobs; work como actividad es incontable.

cards.statement: A CV usually includes education and work experience.
cards.explanation: El CV resume formación y experiencia.

cards.statement: The employer offered me a contract.
cards.explanation: Employer es quien ofrece el contrato.

cards.statement: A colleague is someone who works with you.
cards.explanation: Colleague significa compañero de trabajo.
